senses.gloss: ch. same, esp. to shave, cut the hair (dialectically interchanging with גרד).
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Judges 16:19">Targ. Jud. XVI, 19</cite>; <cite ref="II Samuel 10:4">II Sam. X, 4</cite> Ar. (ed. <he>גדע</he>, ed. Lag. II Sam. l. c. <cite ref="C01379"><he>גרע</he></cite>; cmp.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Lam. R. to I, 1</cite> <he>ג׳ רישיה</he> (8 <he>חד מאת׳</he>) <cite ref="T00152"><he>רבתי</he></cite> he shaved his head.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 96a">Snh. 96ᵃ</cite> (prov.) <he>גְּרַעְתֵּיה לארמאה וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>גרירתיה</he>, Ms. M. <he>גרידתיה</he>) if you shave a gentile, he likes it; hang fire on his beard, and you will get no end of his fun (i.e. if he finds it convenient, he will submit to indignities).—Part. pass. <cite ref="C01338"><he>גְּרִיעַ</he></cite>, f. <cite ref="C01338"><he>גְּרִיעָא</he></cite>
<cite ref="Yevamot 51a">Yeb. 51ᵃ</cite> <he>ג׳ ממאמר</he> is inferior (as to legal power) to &c., v. <cite ref="M00044"><he>מַאֲמָר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Gittin 70a">Gitt. 70ᵃ</cite> <he>ג׳ דכולהו</he> the worst of all.

senses.gloss: as preced. Hif. [Targ. Y. II, Gen. XXX, 11, read מגדעא.] Kidd. 11ᵇ מַגְרְעָה ואזלה she deducts more and more every year.
units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 11b:10">Ib.</cite> [read:] <he>מאי מגרעה</he> what is there for her to deduct from?—
<cite ref="Arakhin 30b:33">Arakh. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>מִיגְּרְעָא ואזלא</he> his obligation grows less (every year, if he chooses to redeem her).
<cite ref="Arakhin 25a:1">Ib. 25ᵃ</cite> <he>לא מִגְּרַע ליה</he> (Rashi <cite ref="M00148"><he>מיג׳</he></cite>) no deduction is allowed him (for fractions of a year).
